info.name: FRED Maps API (GeoFRED) Categories Releases API

description.content:
GeoFRED (the FRED Maps API) exposes geographic / regional views of FRED economic data. Series-group metadata, regional-data lookups across geographies (state, county, MSA, country, census tract, etc.), and GeoJSON shape files for cartographic rendering of FRED indicators.
